title: Broad Haven students draw silver disc

tellings.quote: Broad Haven, UK, 10 students. see a silver disc. They draw pictures. They're identical.

plain: A guest named Merrick, debating on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, cites a case from Broad Haven in the UK. He says ten students saw a silver disc, then each drew a picture of it, and the drawings were identical. He offers it as a case where separate witnesses agree too closely to dismiss.
